Perfect! DADAD is now live! 🎉

**Your crypto price memory game DADAD is deployed and ready to play at:**
**https://dadad-crypto-memory.netlify.app**

## Game Features:
- **Flash Cards**: Shows real-time prices for BTC, ETH, and SOL for 3 seconds
- **Multiple Choice**: Pick the correct price from 4 options
- **Streak System**: Keep going until you get one wrong - tracks your best streak
- **Live Prices**: Uses Pyth Network's Hermes API for real-time crypto prices
- **Responsive Design**: Works great on both desktop and mobile

The game fetches live prices from Pyth Network every round, so you're always testing your memory against current market data. Try to beat your best streak!
